editorial_review_row.content: ACY Securities is an ASIC-regulated Australian broker scoring 7.0/10 from NAFT in 2026. ProZero account offers 0.0 pips + $6 RT with $50 minimum deposit. 2,200+ instruments. Strong in Asia-Pacific markets. Limited brand recognition and single Tier-1 licence. Best for Asia-Pacific traders wanting ASIC regulation with low commission ECN pricing.
